bagPolicy.summary: Stanford Athletics has implemented a Clear Bag Policy to enhance safety and expedite security screenings. Approved bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12"x6"x12" and small clutches no larger than 4.5"x6.5".
allowed: clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12"x6"x12"
small clutch bags or purses no larger than 4.5"x6.5"
bagPolicy.note: Special considerations for medically necessary items and diaper bags, which may be subject to additional screening.

parking.note: Football parking locations and entry routes are event-specific. Review Stanford's current gameday guide and parking map before arrival; prepaid permits may be required for designated lots.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Stanford Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Fixed and portable concession locations sell food and beverages throughout Stanford Stadium. Concessions are cashless, and selection varies by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Stanford Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Stanford Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Stanford Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Stanford Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
